Instant Oatmeal Mix
By: Amy Jeanroy
Published: Friday, May 13, 2011 - 11:28am

Ingredients




8 cups quick cooking oats
1/2 cup brown sugar
2 teaspoons salt
2 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon
1 1/2 teaspoons nutmeg
1 1/2 cups raisins or dried fruit

Preparation

1 Combine all ingredients 2 Place in air tight container 3 To Use: 4 Combine 1/2 cup mix with 1/2 cup water and heat for 1 minute in microwave.

About


It doesn't get any easier than this. Mix up 20 servings for a fraction of the cost of oatmeal packets. We like to divide into ziploc bags and then place the filled bags right into an oatmeal container with lid.
